name: tiles-statusline
description: Colored status line tiles: model, context, 5h session, week limit, prompt cache timer, live MCP/skill activity, loaded plugins and MCP servers.

style.title: Status line style
style.description: powerline: rounded colored tiles (needs a Nerd Font); plain: colored text

bar.title: Status line bars
bar.description: Gauge bars next to the percentages

icons.title: Status line emoji icons
icons.description: Emoji in front of each segment

showResets.title: Status line reset countdowns
showResets.description: Time left before the session and week limits reset

spacing.title: Status line spacing
spacing.description: Blank lines above the status line and between its rows

softRight.title: Status line quiet right tiles
softRight.description: Dimmer plugin and MCP tiles so the gauges stand out

segments.title: Status line left segments
segments.description: In order, among: model context session week cache

segmentsCenter.title: Status line center segments
segmentsCenter.description: active: running MCP call, skill used in the current turn

showBuiltinMcp.title: Status line built-in MCP servers
showBuiltinMcp.description: Show the MCP servers that come with Claude Code and claude.ai (ide, easel, Claude Docs) in the MCP tile

cacheTtl.title: Status line cache lifetime (s)
cacheTtl.description: Fallback when Claude Code does not report the cache expiry: 3600 (1 h) or 300 (5 min)
